svg.title: Retry the operation without repeating its effect
svg.desc: A message is processed with a stable operation key. Repeated attempts persist once or reuse the result. Temporary failures get bounded retries; unprocessable messages go to a dead-letter queue for investigation. The sketch is conceptual, not an exactly-once guarantee.
